diagnostics.message: When VPC configuration is enabled, the dispatcher Lambda needs the VPC execution policy attached before it is created/configured; otherwise Lambda may lack ENI permissions during setup. Add an explicit ordering dependency.

When VPC configuration is enabled, the webhook Lambda needs the VPC execution policy attached before it is created/configured; otherwise Lambda may lack ENI permissions during setup. Add an explicit ordering dependency.
The EventBridge target can become active before the Lambda invoke permission exists. Ensure the target is ordered after the permission that grants EventBridge access to the dispatcher Lambda.
